review_focus: Confirm clientbound/serverbound Configuration registration insertion order used to derive selected packet IDs.
Separate registered-but-unused packet surfaces from packets required by the selected route.
Confirm clientbound finish_configuration is a unit/terminal packet with no hidden payload fields.
Confirm serverbound finish_configuration acknowledgement is a unit packet and identify its handoff role only through the listener handler, not the codec alone.
Confirm registry_data field order and identify every subordinate codec/bound which must receive its own source evidence before production materialization.
Confirm clientbound known-pack list encoding and any list bound relevant to the server request.
Confirm serverbound known-pack response encoding and the maximum accepted element count; keep negotiation decision semantics in the handler review.
Confirm enabled-feature identifier collection wire law used by the selected minecraft:vanilla publication.
Confirm update_tags outer structure and enumerate subordinate registry/tag/identifier/count codecs still requiring evidence.
Confirm common clientbound custom-payload envelope used for the server brand publication.
Confirm common serverbound custom-payload envelope accepted during Configuration.
Confirm ClientInformation field order, UTF-8 bound, signed/unsigned widths and enum/boolean encoding dependencies.
Confirm minecraft:brand payload identifier/value encoding without turning the observed brand string into gameplay state.
Confirm KnownPack is exactly namespace, id and version UTF-8 strings in wire order and identify their subordinate string codec bounds.
Trace exact initial task/publication order: brand, conditional links, enabled features, registry synchronization and subsequent optional/mandatory tasks.
Confirm selected profile exclusions are policy conditions rather than missing registered functionality.
Confirm received client information replaces listener state and that the latest value is the one carried into the later player handoff.
Confirm response is valid only during registry synchronization and is delegated to that active task rather than treated as stateless input.
Confirm the acknowledgement completes JoinWorld, installs the Play clientbound protocol and immediately enters the prepared spawn path.
Record duplicate/admission checks and all state passed into the inseparable spawn handoff.
Confirm the selected vanilla common custom-payload handler performs no gameplay-relevant state mutation for the client brand payload.
Confirm requested known-pack publication precedes registry packing and identify the state retained until the client response arrives.
Confirm negotiated known-pack set controls registry packing and that registry_data packets precede exactly one update_tags publication.
Confirm exact-list equality selects requested packs and every other accepted response selects the empty set before publication/task completion.
Trace saved/default spawn resolution, target spawn position and radius-3 player-spawn chunk request; identify which readiness may be satisfied by an already-loaded pregenerated world.
Confirm chunk-load and entity-readiness conditions that must hold before the task can expose a prepared spawn/player capability.
Confirm clientbound finish_configuration is sent only after prior Configuration work and prepared-spawn dependencies have completed.
Identify the minimum fresh-player Play/bootstrap output and state changes immediately caused by the Configuration acknowledgement handoff.
Separate source-inseparable client-visible bootstrap from later world visibility/chunk streaming work that belongs to the next milestone.
